name: screen-tools
title: Screen Tools
description: Rotate an external display from the menu bar and switch the iTerm2 profile to match the screen the terminal is on.
author: dworznik

commands.name: display-rotation
commands.title: Display Rotation
commands.subtitle: displayplacer
commands.description: Menu bar item for flipping an external display between its natural and 90 degree rotation.

preferences.name: persistentId
preferences.title: Display Persistent ID
preferences.description: Persistent screen id of the display to rotate, as printed by `displayplacer list`.

preferences.name: naturalArgs
preferences.title: Natural Layout Arguments
preferences.description: Full displayplacer argument string that puts every screen in its natural (degree 0) layout.

preferences.name: rotatedArgs
preferences.title: Rotated Layout Arguments
preferences.description: Full displayplacer argument string that puts the display in its 90 degree layout.

commands.name: iterm-profile-switch
commands.title: Switch iTerm Profile for Current Screen
commands.description: Switches the frontmost iTerm2 session to the profile that matches the screen its window is on.

preferences.name: screenNamePrefix
preferences.title: External Screen Name Prefix
preferences.description: Case-insensitive prefix of the external screen's name, e.g. the vendor name shown in System Settings › Displays.

preferences.name: externalProfile
preferences.title: External Screen Profile
preferences.description: iTerm2 profile to use when the window is on the matching external screen.

preferences.name: defaultProfile
preferences.title: Default Profile
preferences.description: iTerm2 profile to use on every other screen.
